title: Space Station Alpha
intro: You wake up from cryo-sleep aboard Space Station Alpha. Something is wrong - the station is on emergency power and the corridors are eerily quiet. You need to find out what happened and restore the station's systems.

cryo_bay.name: Cryo-Sleep Bay
cryo_bay.description: Rows of cryo-pods line the walls, all empty except for yours. Emergency lights cast everything in red. A door leads north to the main corridor.

items.name: tablet
items.description: A personal data tablet. Its last log entry shows 'System failure detected. Emergency protocols initiated.'

corridor_central.name: Central Corridor
corridor_central.description: The main corridor of the station. Signs point to different sections: Bridge (north), Engineering (east), Medical (west), and Cryo Bay (south).

bridge.name: Command Bridge
bridge.description: The station's command center. Multiple screens display error messages. The captain's chair sits empty. Through the viewport, you see distant stars.

items.name: log
items.description: The captain's log: 'Unidentified energy signature detected. Evacuating non-essential personnel. I'm staying to secure the station.'

items.name: keycard
items.description: A captain's keycard with full access permissions.
items.use_message: You swipe the keycard. Authorization granted.

engineering.name: Engineering Bay
engineering.description: The heart of the station. The main reactor is running on minimal power. Control panels flash warnings. A door leads to the reactor core (north).

items.name: toolkit
items.description: A complete engineering toolkit with various repair implements.
items.use_message: You open the toolkit. The tools might help repair damaged systems.

items.name: manual
items.description: A reactor maintenance manual. It emphasizes the importance of proper cooling procedures.

reactor_core.name: Reactor Core
reactor_core.description: The station's fusion reactor pulses with contained energy. Warning signs are posted everywhere. This is where the power comes from.

items.name: coolant
items.description: Emergency coolant reserves. Critical for reactor safety.
items.use_message: You activate the emergency coolant. The reactor temperature begins to stabilize.

medical.name: Medical Bay
medical.description: The station's medical facility. Empty beds line the walls. Medical supplies are scattered about. A door leads to the laboratory (north).

items.name: medkit
items.description: A fully stocked medical kit with various medicines and bandages.
items.use_message: You apply the medkit. Your health improves. Always good to be prepared.

items.name: scanner
items.description: A medical tricorder-style scanner. It can detect life signs and environmental hazards.
items.use_message: You activate the scanner. It beeps softly, displaying environmental data.

laboratory.name: Research Laboratory
laboratory.description: A high-tech laboratory with sophisticated equipment. Research notes are scattered everywhere. Someone was studying something important here.

items.name: sample
items.description: An unusual crystalline sample contained in a stasis field. It emits a faint blue glow.

items.name: notes
items.description: Research notes: 'The crystal exhibits properties unlike anything we've seen. It may be the key to understanding the energy signature.'
